findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_plan, get_checkout_link, quote_ride, start_booking, plan_seattle_trip, find_events_near, find_things_to_do · Private data: plan_trip, get_service_info, start_booking, compare_airport_options, compare_parking_vs_ride, compare_rental_vs_ride · Public sink: get_plan, get_checkout_link · Destructive: remove_from_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_plan, get_checkout_link, quote_ride, start_booking, plan_seattle_trip, find_events_near, find_things_to_do · Private data: plan_trip, get_service_info, start_booking, compare_airport_options, compare_parking_vs_ride, compare_rental_vs_ride · Public sink: get_plan, get_checkout_link · Destructive: remove_from_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.detail: Tool "get_service_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
